title: 第112章 快一些恢复的办法第111章 东西要回来了
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
谢云开迈步走了进去，走到桌边坐下把那只木匣放在桌面上，打开匣盖，那团暗金色的光芒和那层薄薄的灵根本源依然安安静静地躺在匣底，微弱的光晕透过匣口溢出来，在桌面上投下一小片暖色的光。
他低头看了一眼那团光芒，然后抬眼看了一下江欲。
江欲没有多说话，她站起来，走到谢云开身边，伸手按在了他的肩膀上。
她的灵力顺着掌心渗进去的时候，他感觉到自己的经脉正在被她一点一点地探明位置。
那团暗金色的光芒被她从他的木匣中牵引出来，顺着她掌心的路线缓缓地涌入他的经脉，沿着那些已经干涸了很久的灵根路径缓慢地向前推进着。
那些他已经快要想不起来的、灵力在经脉中流动时的触感正在一点一点地回到他的感知里。
他低下头看着自己的手，手指蜷了一下，然后又张开，像是在确认自己真的能感觉到那层正在恢复的灵力波动。
江欲收回手往后退了半步，看着他低头端详自己掌心的模样，等了两息之后她开口了。
“灵根虽然是放回去了，但要重新稳固起来还需要不少时间。”
“如果你想更快一些，还有一种方法。“
谢云开抬起头来看她，那双眼睛里还带着一层刚刚恢复灵根之后还不太确定的茫然：“什么方法？“
江欲看着他，视线在他脸上停了一瞬，然后她往前迈了半步，两人的距离从一臂缩短到了半臂。
“双修。神魂和灵力一起交融的那种，比你自己慢慢巩固快得多。“
谢云开的手指在桌面边缘顿了一下。
他看着她，想要从她的表情里找到一丝“我在逗你玩“的痕迹，可她的表情坦坦荡荡的，没有笑也没有促狭，像是在陈述一件她已经确认过有效的事情。
他的目光从她的眼睛移到她的嘴角，又移回来，像是想要在她脸上找到什么可以让他拒绝的东西，可他什么都没找到。
他沉默了一会儿，然后低下头去，手指搭在木匣边缘微微收拢了一下，声音比方才低了一点，像是终于把自己那层硬壳撬开了一条缝：“……要怎么做。“
江欲偏了偏头，伸手扣住了他的手腕，力道不重不轻的，把他从桌边的椅子带了起来，往床榻的方向走了两步。
江欲带着他走到了床沿边，然后她的另一只手抬起来，指尖搭上了他外袍的领口边沿。
他的肩头在这之前微微一紧，然后松开了，她掌心里的温度已经透过布料传了过来。

谢云开低着头，目光落在自己衣襟边缘的系带上，那根系带正在她的手指间缓缓地松开。
烛火在灯罩里跳了一下，然后恢复了平稳。窗纸上的月光正在缓慢地移动着，从窗棂的一侧移到了另一侧，把那道横在两个人之间的影子从长变短又变长，像是在替房间里的时间做着无声的计数。
她在灯下偏头看他的时候，他的目光也正好撞进了她的视野，烛火隔着半寸空气把他的轮廓勾得比平时更清晰了一些，他的喉结正在缓慢地动着，像是一条终于被放开了之后正在适应新流向的溪流，还带着不确定深浅的试探。
她伸手拉住他，他顺着那道力俯下来的时候肩头正好压住了她衣料的一角，那层料子在灯光下皱起一层细纹又慢慢散开了。
谢云开的呼吸沉在两人之间那道窄窄的间隙里，指尖正搭在她肩侧的床褥上微微收着，像是在确认脚下那块新落下来的地面承得住他。
夜风从窗缝里漏进来，把烛火吹得弯了一下又直起来，整个房间沉在一种被什么东西从内部捂暖了的安静里，像是一个终于被打开了很久没推过的门的房间，空气正在试探性地重新流动起来。
系统在江欲的脑海里发出一声尖锐的、几乎要破音的尖叫。
【宿主！！！我只是让你触发条件拿留影石，你居然直接做到这种程度了？！】
江欲的意识还带着一层刚刚从亲密中退出来之后的松弛，她在心里回了一句，语气懒洋洋的，带着一种“你大惊小怪什么“的从容。
“你没说不能做到这种程度啊。而且你不是说亲密接触能加深神魂连接吗？我这不正是在帮你加速完成任务。“
系统像是被她这句话噎住了，透明体在神识空间里剧烈地晃了两下，过了好几息才重新找回自己的声音。
【……行吧，宿主你赢了。因为你们这次的亲密接触已经超过了神魂连接的基础门槛，我这边触发了额外奖励，灵根修复完成，并且比之前更强了，这部分奖励已经直接生效在谢云开身上了。你仔细感受一下他现在的灵力波动。】
江欲眨了眨眼，收回意识，目光落在面前正在慢慢直起身来的谢云开身上。
谢云开正低着头，他的手指还搭在床沿边缘没有收回来，像是在感受什么。
他的灵力波动正在以一种肉眼可见的速度稳定下来，那种稳定和她方才帮他放回灵根时完全不一样。
他抬起头来，那双眼睛里带着一层他自己都没有完全消化的震惊，他试着将灵力聚拢到指尖，一股比方才浑厚了数倍的灵光从他指腹亮起，比他被废灵根之前全盛时期的气息还要强出不少。
他的嘴唇动了一下，像是想说什么，可他还没来得及开口，就感觉到了那股灵力在经脉中流过一个特定节点时忽然卡了一下。
那层卡顿很轻微，限制着他的灵力流速，像是某种正在缓慢呼吸的封印，把他灵力的上限压在一个他能够承受的范围之内。
他抬起头来看向江欲，像是想要一个解释。
江欲靠坐在床沿边，看着他那副正在反复测试自己灵力的模样。

“灵根我给你修好了，确实比以前更强。可你的身体已经废了太久了，经脉和丹田扛不住灵根全盛状态下的灵力冲击。”

content_en:
Xie Yunkai stepped in, walked to the table, sat down, put the wooden box on the table, and opened the lid. The dark golden light and the thin layer of spiritual roots were still lying quietly at the bottom of the box. A faint halo overflowed through the mouth of the box, casting a small patch of warm light on the table.
He glanced down at the ball of light, then raised his eyes at Jiang Yu.
Jiang Yu didn't say much. She stood up, walked to Xie Yunkai, and put her hand on his shoulder.
When her spiritual power seeped into her palm, he felt that her meridians were being explored bit by bit.
The dark golden light was pulled out of his wooden box by her, and slowly poured into his meridians along the route in her palm, advancing slowly along the paths of those spiritual roots that had dried up for a long time.
Those touches that he had almost forgotten when spiritual power flowed through his meridians were returning to his perception bit by bit.
He lowered his head and looked at his hand, curled his fingers, and then opened them again, as if to confirm that he could really feel the recovering spiritual power fluctuations.
Jiang Yu retracted her hand and took half a step back. She looked at the way he lowered his head and looked at the palm of her hand. After waiting for two breaths, she spoke.
"Although the spiritual roots have been put back, it will take a lot of time to stabilize them again."
"If you want to go faster, there's a way."
Xie Yunkai raised his head to look at her, his eyes still filled with uncertainty as if he had just recovered his spiritual roots: "What method?"
Jiang Yu looked at him, her eyes stopped on his face for a moment, and then she took half a step forward, and the distance between them shortened from one arm to half an arm.
"Double cultivation. The kind where the soul and spiritual power blend together, which is much faster than slowly consolidating on your own."
Xie Yunkai's fingers paused on the edge of the table.
He looked at her, trying to find a trace of "I'm teasing you" in her expression, but her expression was frank, without smiling or constricting, as if she was stating something that she had confirmed to be valid.
His eyes moved from her eyes to the corners of her mouth and back again, as if he wanted to find something on her face that he could refuse, but he found nothing.
He was silent for a while, then lowered his head, put his fingers on the edge of the wooden box and tightened it slightly. His voice was a little lower than before, as if he had finally opened a crack in his hard shell: "...What should we do?"
Jiang Yu tilted his head, reached out and grabbed his wrist, with moderate force, and took him up from the chair beside the table and took two steps towards the bed.
Jiang Yu led him to the edge of the bed, then raised her other hand and put her fingertips on the edge of the collar of his robe.
His shoulders tensed slightly before this, and then relaxed. The warmth in her palms had spread through the fabric.
Xie Yunkai lowered his head, his eyes falling on the lace on the edge of his clothes, which was slowly loosening between her fingers.
The candle flame danced in the lampshade, then returned to a steady state. The moonlight on the window paper was moving slowly, from one side of the window lattice to the other, making the shadow between the two people grow shorter and longer, as if silently counting the time in the room.
When she turned her head to look at him under the lamp, his eyes happened to hit her field of vision. The candlelight made his outline clearer than usual through half an inch of air. His Adam's apple was moving slowly, like a stream adapting to the new direction after being finally let go, with an uncertain depth of trial.
She stretched out her hand to hold him, and when he leaned down along with the force, his shoulder happened to press the corner of her clothes. The layer of material wrinkled into fine lines under the light and slowly spread out.
Xie Yunkai's breathing sank in the narrow gap between the two of them, and his fingertips were resting on the mattress beside her shoulder, slightly curled up.He stood, as if confirming that the newly fallen ground beneath his feet could bear him.
The night breeze leaked in through the cracks in the window, causing the candlelight to bend and then straighten. The whole room sank into a kind of silence that was warmed by something from the inside. It was like a room that had finally opened a door that had not been pushed for a long time, and the air was tentatively flowing again.
The system let out a sharp, almost sound-breaking scream in Jiang Yu's mind.
【Host! ! ! I just asked you to trigger the conditions to get the image stone, but you actually did it directly? ! 】
Jiang Yu's consciousness was still filled with a layer of relaxation after withdrawing from intimacy. She replied in her heart, with a lazy tone and a calmness of "What are you making a fuss about?"
"You didn't say you couldn't do it to this extent. And didn't you say that close contact can deepen the connection between the soul and the soul? I'm not just helping you speed up the task."
The system seemed to be choked by her words. The transparent body shook violently twice in the consciousness space, and it took several breaths to find its voice again.
[...Okay, host, you win. Because your close contact this time has exceeded the basic threshold of soul connection, I have triggered additional rewards. The spiritual root repair is completed and it is stronger than before. This part of the reward has directly taken effect on Xie Yunkai. Carefully feel his current spiritual power fluctuations. 】
Jiang Yu blinked and regained consciousness, his eyes falling on Xie Yunkai who was slowly straightening up in front of him.
Xie Yunkai was lowering his head, his fingers still resting on the edge of the bed, as if he was feeling something.
His spiritual power fluctuations were stabilizing at a speed visible to the naked eye. The stability was completely different from when she helped him put back his spiritual roots.
He raised his head, with a layer of shock in his eyes that he had not fully digested. He tried to gather his spiritual energy to his fingertips, and a spiritual light that was several times thicker than before lit up from his fingertips. It was much stronger than the aura in his heyday before he was deposed.
His lips moved as if he wanted to say something, but before he could speak, he felt the spiritual power suddenly get stuck as it flowed through a specific node in his meridians.
That layer of lag was very slight, limiting the flow rate of his spiritual power, like some kind of slow-breathing seal, limiting the upper limit of his spiritual power to a range that he could bear.
He raised his head and looked at Jiang Yu, as if he wanted an explanation.
Jiang Yu leaned on the edge of the bed and looked at him as he was repeatedly testing his spiritual power.
"I have repaired your spiritual root for you, and it is indeed stronger than before. But your body has been disabled for too long, and your meridians and Dantian cannot withstand the impact of spiritual power when your spiritual root is in its full state."
